name: vibe
description: Vibe sessions and handoff in any git repository, with fleet orchestration, seed refresh and ticket workflows

interface.shortDescription: Vibe sessions and handoff in any git repository.
interface.longDescription: Vibe sessions let anyone (an executive, designer, product manager or engineer) change a product in any git repository from the in-app browser, with its local plan and decision table as the record, and finish it as a pull request they take through review or pass it to design and engineering. An optional provider plugin adds one tracker's, organization's or repository's knowledge.
defaultPrompt: Hand this vibe session off to design and engineering.
